Zero-Mistake Work Techniques: Practical Methods Based on Cognitive Science

Instructor: Masami Utsuide (practical people-development specialist, AI × human hybrid coach)

Content: You can't prevent work mistakes through individual attention or experience alone. This seminar uses cognitive science to explain why people make mistakes, and introduces concrete prevention strategies you can put into practice at your workplace right away. Learn scientific approaches to reliably improve your work performance. (46 minutes)

Target audience: Hanno Chamber of Commerce & Industry members (non-members should inquire)

How to watch: Works on both PC and smartphone. Click or scan the QR code.

Note: Web seminar viewing is a member benefit of the Hanno Chamber of Commerce & Industry. Members who want ID/password access should contact their assigned representative.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-cci.or.jp/xo_event/xo_event-2637/
